newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close at new high with Dow support.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close at new high with Dow support.

text.p: French shares closed at a new closing high for the year but off their best levels, after a rally on the back of Wall Street's bull run, traders said.
Alcatel fell sharply in late trading on market talk it had won the bidding for electronics group Thomson but the missiles activities were being sold to Lagardere, traders said.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 24.66 points or 1.15 percent at 2,168.28 while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,172.5 from a settle of 2,149 on Monday. The new year high is 2,176.45. Volume was 6.65 billion francs.
* The life high of the CAC-40 is at 2,360.98 since Feb 1994
* Turnover on Alcatel was 240 million francs, making it one of the biggest volumes. It was down 2.22 percent at 444.90.
* Lagardere rose 2.94 percent to 133.10. The books-to-missiles conglomerate wants to merge its Matra unit with Thomson-CSF if it won Thomson SA.
* Cie Generale des Eaux firmed 5.08 percent to 620 francs and had higher highest volume of 804 million francs, following an analysts meeting on Monday's first-half results
* Its SGE construction unit ended up 14.74 percent at 102 francs, buoyed by restructuring plans.
* Lyonnaise des Eaux rose 1.95 percent to 464.80 francs
* Elf Aquitaine, which followed the soaring trend in oil prices, closed up 1.24 percent at 409 francs, on turnover of 380 million francs. Total closed up 0.87 percent at 416.50 francs

* Other big gainers included Rhone-Poulenc, up 2.27 percent at 144 francs and regaining some ground after recent losses, Schneider up 2.69 percent at 247.80 francs, Lafarge up 2.62 percent at 310 and L'Oreal up 2.35 percent at 1,830.
* Second-line stocks also swept up, with Colas, Zodiac, Euro RSCG and Credit National seeing gains of more than four percent
* Fallers included Bouygues, which shed 0.2 percent to 507 francs and Eurotunnel, down 0.64 percent to 7.80. PSA Peugeot fell 0.86 percent to 576
* The next target on the CAC index on the upside is 2,180
* U.S. September consumer prices data are due on Wednesday at 1230 GMT.
